content.bridge_context: Understanding numbers that are not 'whole', but parts of a whole.

units.title: What is a Fraction?
units.explanation: A fraction represents a part of a whole or a part of a group.
units.dual_language_instruction: Cut a pizza into 4 equal slices. One slice is 1/4. / एक पिज्जा को 4 बराबर भागों में काटें। एक भाग 1/4 है।

units.title: Numerator and Denominator
units.explanation: The top number (numerator) tells how many parts we have; the bottom number (denominator) tells the total number of parts.
units.dual_language_instruction: In 3/5, which number is the denominator? / 3/5 में कौन सी संख्या हर (denominator) है?
